title: Effect of ancillary ligand substitution on photocatalytic hydrogen production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4441-4450
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00423C, Paper
Rahat Gupta, Olivier Schott, Gabriel M. Mercier, Arindam Saha, Ilyes Oubaha, Garry S. Hanan, Amlan K. Pal
Effect of ancillary ligand with extended π surface on the photophysical properties and photocatalytic hydrogen production activity of bis(quinolinyl)isothiocyanate Pt(II) complexes were studied. The complexes were found to be sustainable for HER.
